sources.entry: Manage My Damn Life - Manage my Damn Life (MMDL) is a self-hosted front end for managing your CalDAV tasks and calendars. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Manage my Damn Life (MMDL) is a self-hosted web front end for managing CalDAV tasks and calendars.
summary.what_it_does: MMDL provides a browser interface for CalDAV tasks (VTODO), including sub-tasks and fields such as due date, status, description, and recurrence. It also manages calendar events. Users can connect multiple CalDAV accounts and multiple user accounts. Tasks can be viewed as a list, in a Gantt view, or on a calendar, and custom task filters can be created. The README states it is desktop-first with a "responsive-ish" layout and supports OAuth, currently for Google Calendars. It uses the tsdav library for CalDAV access and has been tested with Nextcloud, Radicale, and Baikal.
use_cases: manage CalDAV tasks in a web browser
view tasks as a Gantt chart
manage calendar events on a self-hosted server
how_to_run: Refer to the installation documentation linked from the README (not included in the README text).
notable: Works with any CalDAV server supported by tsdav; tested with Nextcloud, Radicale, and Baikal
Task views as list, Gantt, and calendar
Multiple CalDAV accounts and multiple user accounts
caveats: Beta state; caution advised with production data
Desktop-first; mobile use is handled by other clients per the README
Planned features such as full RFC 5545 field support and drag-and-drop are not yet implemented
